## Tensions

## Stated Assumptions

- Eighteen months of referred and declined cases is enough history to show whether the model agrees with the underwriters, which is what the pilot is being asked to demonstrate.
- The proposal can be written before the extract arrives, because the pilot design does not depend on the field-level detail.

## Unstated Assumptions

- The team treated the extract as an analytics request. It is a member-data request, and the data-sharing review board is the route it has to take.
